Bart & Associates, Inc. (B&A) is a technology services company supporting government and other clients. B&A is seeking an Application Developer/Programmer to support a federal government client by developing, testing, implementing, and maintaining web and database applications throughout the software development life cycle. The role also involves translating user requirements into application and database designs, programming in relevant technologies, troubleshooting defects, and communicating technical processes.

Responsibilities
Develops, tests, implements, and maintains web and database applications across the full software development life cycle
Translates user requirements into end-to-end application/database designs with multiple interfaces
Programs in project-relevant languages and frameworks (e.g., Java, J2EE, JSP, HTML, XML, Spring, Hibernate, CSS, JavaScript, Apache Tomcat, Git)
Troubleshoots and resolves defects; documents requirements, procedures, and reports; communicates technical protocols and processes to technical and non-technical stakeholders; plans work, sets goals, and monitors progress to delivery
Qualification
Active TS/SCI Clearance with FS Poly
Preferred
Bachelor's Degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Business, or related scientific or technical discipline
Relevant certifications in programming and development, cloud and infrastructure, architecture and design, or other related networking, cybersecurity, or technology disciplines
Active TS/SCI with an FS Poly adjudicated within the last five (5) years
